sections.section_name: Section A - Objective Type / MCQs / True-False

questions.question_text: Which spreadsheet function is used to return the highest numerical value in a selected range of cells?
Which presentation view is best used for easily reordering, deleting, and organizing multiple slides in a digital presentation?
What type of malicious software encrypts a user's files and demands financial payment in exchange for the decryption key?
True or False: In an electronic spreadsheet application, rows are identified by alphabetical letters and columns are identified by numbers.
What is the primary purpose of a Slide Master in presentation software?
options: A) To run spell check on all slides
B) To control the uniform appearance and layout of all slides in the presentation
questions.answer: B) To control the uniform appearance and layout of all slides in the presentation

questions.question_text: Which of the following represents the strongest and most secure password configuration against brute-force attacks?
True or False: Animation triggers allow a specific animation effect to start only when a designated object on the slide is actively clicked by the user.
Which symbol must always be placed at the very beginning of a cell's contents to initiate a mathematical formula calculation?
A firewall in a computer network is primarily designed to perform which of the following functions?
options: B) Monitor and block unauthorized incoming and outgoing network traffic
C) Delete spam emails from the inbox automatically
questions.answer: B) Monitor and block unauthorized incoming and outgoing network traffic

questions.question_text: True or False: Data filtering permanently deletes rows from a spreadsheet that do not match the specified filter criteria.
Explain the difference between sorting and filtering data in an electronic spreadsheet. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Sorting arranges data in ascending or descending order, while filtering temporarily hides rows that do not meet specific criteria, displaying only the required information.

questions.question_text: Define the specific function of slide transitions in presentation software. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Slide transitions are visual and audio effects applied when moving seamlessly from one slide to the next during an on-screen digital presentation.

questions.question_text: What is the primary purpose of installing antivirus software on a computer system? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Antivirus software is designed to detect, quarantine, and remove malicious programs like Trojans, worms, and viruses to protect the system from data corruption.

questions.question_text: Briefly describe how a Mixed Cell Reference works in spreadsheet formulas. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: A mixed reference keeps either the row or the column absolute using a single dollar sign, allowing the other dimension to change relatively when copied.

questions.question_text: What does the 'HTTPS' prefix in a website address signify regarding cyber safety? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: The 'HTTPS' prefix indicates that the website uses an encrypted communication protocol, ensuring that data transmitted between the user's browser and server remains secure.

questions.question_text: Write the exact spreadsheet formulas required to calculate the total sum of cells C2 to C10, and also to count the numerical entries in that same range. [30-40 words]
questions.answer: To find the total sum, you must use the formula =SUM(C2:C10). To calculate the exact count of numerical entries within that specific range, you should apply the formula =COUNT(C2:C10) in your chosen target cell.

questions.question_text: Explain how utilizing a Slide Master saves time when designing a 50-slide corporate digital presentation. [30-40 words]
questions.answer: A Slide Master applies universal formatting, background colors, logos, and font styles across all slides simultaneously. This eliminates the need to manually format each of the 50 slides individually, ensuring consistency and saving significant design time.

questions.question_text: Read the case: A student downloads a free cracked version of an expensive game. Soon after, their computer slows down drastically, and unknown pop-ups appear constantly. Identify the likely cyber threat and outline three immediate steps to secure the PC. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: The student likely downloaded malicious malware, specifically adware or a dangerous Trojan, hidden within the cracked software file. To secure the PC, they must immediately disconnect from the local internet network, run a comprehensive system scan using updated antivirus software, and permanently uninstall the unauthorized application from the system dashboard.

questions.question_text: A teacher has a spreadsheet of 40 students with their marks in Science out of 100 in Column D (D2:D41). She needs to assign a "Pass" or "Fail" status in Column E (passing is 40). Write the logical IF function she should use in E2 and explain how to apply it to all students efficiently. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: The teacher should enter the logical formula =IF(D2>=40, "Pass", "Fail") in cell E2. To apply this to all 40 students efficiently without retyping, she must select cell E2, click the small square fill handle at the bottom-right corner, and drag it down to cell E41 to auto-fill the relative formulas.
